summary_en: Introduces SCFusion, a forward-looking-sonar/camera fusion network for underwater object detection. A vision-guided cross-attention module injects high-level optical semantics into sonar features, while a cross-modal relation module models dependencies between visual attributes and sonar geometry; evaluation on the multimodal UMOD dataset reports improved robustness in complex underwater scenes.

summary_en: Presents PAT-Mamba, an all-in-one blind photoacoustic-tomography restoration model designed to recover images under multiple acquisition degradations without knowing the degradation type in advance. The state-space architecture jointly addresses sparse channels, sparse angles, bandwidth loss, and measurement noise, reducing the need for separate degradation-specific networks.

summary_en: Describes PAM3, a human-scale hybrid system combining full-view hemispherical multi-wavelength photoacoustic tomography with reflection/transmission ultrasound tomography. The system includes 512 broadband ultrasound channels, multi-point optical illumination, fully 3D sound-speed inversion using FWI, and iterative PA reconstruction that incorporates the recovered sound-speed field and detector responses.
